mechanism: BTC-led catch-up: when BTC's 60-minute spot return is at or above its trailing-30-day 99.5th percentile (thresholds fixed per UTC day), buy the 3 of the other 9 coins with the lowest 60-minute return, equal weight, for 4 hours
orthogonality: Bets on slow diffusion of a BTC move into less liquid coins, a relative state no survivor traded. Differs from v58 (weekly taker-flow ranks, rejected) and v52/v53 (multi-day momentum, rejected): event-triggered by a BTC move and held for hours.
weekend_coverage: Binance spot klines are 24/7; no signal vacuum.
knowledge_disclosure: Designed after v60 (round 2026-10c), whose development window used 2022-2023 spot 1m prices of the same coins for downside cascades; no BTC-surge or laggard statistic was computed. Only 2025 BTC 1m move sizes were looked at otherwise. Operator rule set before freezing: if v61 fails, alpha search stops and the project moves to a beta-with-risk-control allocation.
cost_napkin: Two fills of 12 bps per trade: 0.24% per 4-hour hold at gross 1; the laggards must out-earn that plus their drift.
semantics: Grid: the full 1-minute UTC grid from the first to the last BTCUSDT spot kline; every symbol's close is reindexed to it, NaN where the minute is missing (no fill).
r60[s][t] = close[s][t] / close[s][t-60] - 1 on grid rows; NaN if either is missing.

BTC threshold for UTC day D: numpy linear quantile(quantile) of the finite BTCUSDT r60 values on rows in [D - baseline_days, D). If there are fewer than min_baseline_fraction x baseline_days x 1440 finite values, no trigger on day D.
Trigger at row t in day D: BTCUSDT r60[t] >= threshold(D), finite.

Legs: among the non-BTC symbols with finite r60[t], if there are at least min_universe of them, the legs symbols with the lowest r60[t], ties ordered by (r60, symbol name); otherwise no trade and no hold starts.

Hold: a trade at t sets gross_weight / legs on each leg on rows t .. t + hold_minutes - 1, legs fixed during the hold; triggers inside an open hold are ignored; the next trigger may fire from row t + hold_minutes. BTCUSDT weight is always 0.
Output: weights on the grid, one column per symbol, 0 elsewhere, no NaN, sum of absolute weights <= 1.
limitations: Spot fills at the minute close one bar after the decision (ADR-018 2.3); slippage only through the cost scenarios, although laggard coins are the less liquid ones.
